summary_en: 120,000 shares (0.8% S/O) | ¥70M upper limit | open-market purchase via broker | 13 Aug 2026–31 Mar 2027 | no price ceiling disclosed. Primary use: restricted-stock awards for management; secondary use: shareholder returns targeting 10%+ payout ratio during medium-term plan.
title_en: Notice regarding Decision on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On 10 June 2026, Kodama Chemical Industry's board approved a treasury stock acquisition programme under the Companies Act (Article 165, paragraph 3). The company will acquire up to 120,000 ordinary shares (0.8% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥70 million via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Standard Market, with execution delegated to a securities company. The acquisition window runs from 13 August 2026 through 31 March 2027 (with Q1 FY2027 results to be announced on 12 August 2026).

The stated purpose is twofold: primary use as restricted-stock awards linked to company growth and management compensation; secondary use to support shareholder returns and facilitate dynamic capital allocation during the medium-term business plan period, targeting a minimum 10% payout ratio. No price ceiling is disclosed. As of 12 August 2026 (day before the acquisition window opens), the company will hold 98,854 treasury shares against a denominator of 15,538,290 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
